name: Góc Ăn Vặt (Snack Corner)
notes: Chuyen banh trang tron/bo/cuon. Thuong ngay mo 11am-10pm, 4.3 sao. ⚠️ Thu 5 26/11 la THANKSGIVING - goi (714) 946-1993 xac nhan mo cua truoc khi di. 15496 Magnolia St #107, Westminster 92683.

name: Cosm Los Angeles
notes: Immersive dome 87ft (shared reality) — Hollywood Park, canh SoFi Stadium. 1252 District Dr, Inglewood 90305.

name: The Getty Center
notes: Bao tang nghe thuat tren doi Brentwood. Vao cua MIEN PHI (dau xe tra phi ~25$). View LA + bien dep. Nghi Thu 2. 1200 Getty Center Dr, LA 90049.

name: The Broad
notes: Bao tang nghe thuat duong dai DTLA, canh Walt Disney Concert Hall. Vao cua MIEN PHI (nen dat timed ticket truoc). Infinity Mirror Room phai dat rieng, het ve rat nhanh. Nghi Thu 2. 221 S Grand Ave 90012.

name: Griffith Observatory
notes: View toan canh LA + Hollywood Sign. Vao cua MIEN PHI (dau xe tra phi). Nghi Thu 2. Di xe chieu toi ngam hoang hon + den thanh pho. 2800 E Observatory Rd, LA 90027.

name: UNU Cafe (boba buckets)
notes: Boba buckets viral + nhieu loai thach/jelly ($1-2/mon). Mo moi ngay 11am-10pm. Bai dau xe nho mien phi, KHONG cho ngoi. O Irvine (OC, ~20ph tu Little Saigon). 92 Corporate Park Ste D, Irvine 92606. Luu y: mot so listing ghi 'Jam Jam' o dia chi nay - co the doi ten, check lai khi toi.

name: Balboa Island (Newport Beach)
notes: Dao nho o Newport Beach (OC): phà Balboa Island Ferry (re, cho duoc ca xe + xe dap), tam bien, dao pho Marine Ave (Balboa Bar / frozen banana). ~25 phut tu Little Saigon -> de Ngay 1 (OC). KHONG gan Santa Monica (cach ~1 tieng).
